basis: October20-24 posted effective prices. Same-duration app usage. These estimates describe recurring allocation changes, not a measured invoice reduction.
compute_attribution: Azure bills the three stopped instances through one workspace. Per-instance invoice attribution is not available.
additional_registry_storage_reduction: Unknown until retired unique layers expire after30days. The old entire registry-storage charge of8.23/month is an upper bound, not a saving estimate. Shared live/rollback layers remain.
temporary_costs: Operational CPU restarts and private archive storage retained for30days are additional temporary costs. Their posted invoice impact has not yet been measured.
